<button
                    className="text-link"
                    disabled={writeBlocked}
                    onClick={async () => {
                      if (
                        await execute("notification.read", {
                          notification_id: item.id,
                        })
                      ) {
                        const allowed = [
                          "home",
                          "chat",
                          "mission",
                          "models",
                          "cluster",
                          "settings",
                          "tasks",
                          "planner",
                          "projects",
                          "memory",
                          "agents",
                          "activity",
                          "calendar",
                          "voice",
                          "screen",
                          "notifications",
                          "workflows",
                        ];
                        if (
                          item.target.id &&
                          !storeInspection(item.target.screen, item.target.id)
                        ) {
                          setError(
                            "The related event target could not be retained. Open its screen directly.",
                          );
                          return;
                        }
                        if (allowed.includes(item.target.screen))
                          navigate(item.target.screen as Screen);

rows.source_excerpt:
<button
              className={action.kind === "forget" ? "danger-button" : ""}
              disabled={
                busy ||
                !connected ||
                ((action.kind === "correct" ||
                  action.kind === "analyze" ||
                  action.kind === "alias" ||
                  action.kind === "workflow" ||
                  (action.kind === "review" && action.edit)) &&
                  !content.trim())
              }
              onClick={apply}
            >
              {busy
                ? "Savingâ€¦"
                : action.kind === "forget"
                  ? "Delete memory"
                  : action.kind === "review"
                    ? action.decision === "approve"
                      ? "Approve memory"
                      : action.decision === "reject"
                        ? "Reject suggestion"
                        : "Dismiss suggestion"
                    : action.kind === "analyze"
                      ? "Create suggestion"
                      : action.kind === "consolidate"
                        ? "Find suggestions"
                        : "Save change"}
            </button>

          data-mini-input
          ref={input}
          aria-label="Message HANNI"
          value={draft}
          maxLength={4000}
          rows={2}
          placeholder="Ask HANNI, or / for tools"
          onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(event) => {
            if (event.nativeEvent.isComposing) return;
            if (
              commandMode &&
              capabilities.length &&
              ["ArrowDown", "ArrowUp"].includes(event.key)
            ) {
              event.preventDefault();
              setSelection(
                (value) =>
                  (value +
                    (event.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : capabilities.length - 1)) %
                  capabilities.length,
              );
            } else if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
              event.preventDefault();
              commandMode && capabilities.length
                ? prepare(
                    capabilities[Math.min(selection, capabilities.length - 1)]
                      .name,
                  )
                : submit();
            }
          }}
        />
